This unidentified man was a '''consort''' to [[Hapan]] Lady [[Galney (Lady)|Galney]], but was secretly a spy for the [[Heritage Council]], a group of Hapan nobles bent on overthrowing Hapan [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]. Galney entrusted him with confidential information on the Queen Mother, which he leaked to the Council.
